spots.text: Everything out there has a twin. This is where the others went.

secrets.name: The Leftovers
secrets.text: Behind the bookcase that had no twin is a narrow room where nothing matches: the shelves lean, the chairs are odd, the books are stacked any way. It is a great relief.

meta.label: The Symmetrical Hall
meta.blurb: Everything here has a twin across the aisle, down to the books. You find yourself walking exactly down the middle, and you are not sure you chose to.
